title: Cover and Debt
author: B. M. Quintana
blurb: Sable Kavanagh, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
